briefHtml:
NAV S$10,330,166 — oil broke on the SPR release (watcher −0.624%; ≈flat +0.01% vs the restated Sep 29 base) · listed flag −3.33% (trips the −3% rule — but see glitch) · SEVEN critical riskFlags, 2nd day · Sep 29 restated −S$3.6k (five nights: ~S$76.5k cumulative)

  • Biggest mover: oil broke — WTI −4.19% to $88.72. The US ordered an SPR exchange release of up to 40M barrels (loan repaid with interest; ~200M bbl returned over the next year; SPR to its lowest since 1982), the Saudi East-West pipeline is ~half restored, and US and Iranian officials held separate indirect talks with Qatari mediators Monday. Metals/miners bounced: SLV +0.96% (spot est ~$61.4), GLD +1.32%, GDX +1.34% to $89.07, SILJ +0.22%. US indices flat-to-down (S and P 7,670.84 −0.17%; VIX 16.04); SOX +1.32%. HK faded — HSI −0.48% and Tencent −1.77% to 432.00: the 439 reclaim lasted one session.
  • The one thing: the watcher is misfiring — two days running. Seven critical flags this morning, but verified Tuesday closes show SILJ +0.22% (flag −11.0%), GDX +1.34% (flag −9.0%), SMIC flat (flag −5.1%), Xiaomi −2.55% (flag −7.4%), CDL −2.11% (flag −8.5%) — overstated 5–11pp, wrong signs on the miners. The listed-book −3.33% trip is built on the same bad math (real Tuesday ≈ −1%). Audit the watcher's baseline logic before trusting any single-name flag. On policy: Trump posted the Axios sanctions-relief story is untrue — "I offered them NOTHING!" — even as the Qatar shuttle runs; and the RBA hiked 25bp to 4.60% (unanimous), citing energy and AI-demand tech-goods inflation.

Risk flags — SEVEN critical, second day (glitch confirmed)

  • Flags: SMIC −5.1% · Xiaomi −7.4% · GDX −9.0% · SILJ −11.0% · SLVP −9.8% · CDL −8.5% · Listed book −3.33%. Verified closes contradict every one (wrong sign on GDX/SILJ). Treat magnitudes as noise until the watcher is fixed.
  • Leveraged silver line: 1,777 oz × ~$61.4 × 1.2779 ≈ S$139.4k vs S$56,240 loan ≈ 1.68x → equity ≈ S$83.2k, +1.7% day-recovery. The −10% equity flag was not approached Tuesday.
  • Rates: 10y 5.25% / 30y 5.59% (2002 level); swaps price nearly a full 1pp of hikes over the coming year — but JOLTS and consumer confidence both missed Tuesday. PCE tonight (8:30pm SGT) is the decider.
  • Tencent tell re-broken (432.00 vs 439 tell; failure line 425); mainland China shuts tomorrow for Golden Week. CDL −10% over two sessions on the GET+ review (0.6% of NW). ~35% of net worth non-SGD; USDSGD 1.2779.

Alpha — signals, not advice (~62% cash undeployed)

  • Defense sleeve (15% vs ~0%): oil broke, JOLTS/confidence missed, 10y stalled at 5.25% — the first de-escalation-in-data combination. Signal: soft PCE = first-tranche entry on the reaction; hot PCE with 30y at 5.59% = wait for deeper levels.
  • HK AI barbell (Asia 10% vs ~3%; AI 15% vs ~1%): 439 reclaim failed in one session; Golden Week starts tomorrow; RBA made AI inflation a tightening input. Signal: stand down pre-PCE; next clean window is post-Golden-Week; 425 the line, 439 reclaim with volume the trigger.
  • Silver/miners (real assets 20% vs ~4%): bounce held ~$61.4 under the broken zone; miners outperformed the metal Tuesday (GDX +1.34% vs SLV +0.96%) — first relative-strength flicker since the break. Signal: suspended below $62; watch a $62 reclaim.

trumpWatch.title: SPR exchange release breaks oil: WTI −4.19% to $88.72; up to 40M bbl loaned, ~200M bbl to return over the next year
trumpWatch.detail: The US ordered a Strategic Petroleum Reserve exchange release of up to 40 million barrels — structured as a loan repaid with interest; the program returns ~200M bbl to the reserve over the next year (~20% more than released); bids due Oct 6. Energy Secretary Wright signaled another drawdown is unlikely; the SPR is projected to fall to its lowest level since 1982. Brent came off a $106.77 intraday high. Additional trims: Saudi East-West pipeline ~half restored; covert Hormuz transits continuing (1 transit Sep 27 vs an 85/day baseline; a Kuwaiti KOTC tanker was struck).

trumpWatch.title: Trump: the Axios sanctions-relief story is untrue — "I offered them NOTHING!"; Qatar shuttle talks ran Monday
trumpWatch.detail: Overnight Trump posted that the Axios report claiming he offered Iran sanctions relief and a frozen-funds release is "untrue… I offered them NOTHING!" — cutting near-term deal odds. Yet per Reuters, US and Iranian officials held separate INDIRECT talks with Qatari mediators Monday in New York; Araghchi says Iran awaits the US response via Qatar and the Supreme Leader's conditions must be met to reopen Hormuz. Iran's 7-point plan: end hostilities in Iran AND Lebanon, lift the naval blockade, unfreeze assets, end oil sanctions → phased Hormuz reopening within 7 days. Trump in the Oval Office: "We're going to win… it's going to go pretty quickly." Rubio met the Saudi FM Sep 28 on Yemen/Houthi maritime risk.

trumpWatch.title: RBA HIKED 25bp to 4.60% (unanimous) — 4th hike of 2026, highest since late 2011; cites energy AND AI tech-goods inflation
trumpWatch.detail: The RBA raised the cash rate to 4.60%, its 4th hike of 2026 (Feb/Mar/May/Sep). Statement: "Inflation remains elevated and some of the upside risks flagged in August are materialising" — citing energy (Middle East conflict broadening), technology (AI demand pushing tech-goods prices up globally — a direct read-through to the AI-bottleneck theme), and domestic capacity. Housing prices falling in most capitals; door open to further increases. Markets fully price another hike by Feb 2027; ANZ tips November (4.85%). Australia Aug CPI lands today 09:30 SGT.

trumpWatch.title: Rates: 10y 5.25%, 30y 5.59% (2002 level); nearly 1pp of hikes priced over a year — but JOLTS and consumer confidence missed
trumpWatch.detail: TE daily print: 10y +1bp to 5.25% (intraday narrative: climb toward 5.28%, 2007 highs); 30y ^TYX +0.59% to 5.59%, surpassing 5.6% — a 2002/dot-com-bust level. Swaps now price nearly a full percentage point of Fed hikes over the coming year. But Tuesday brought the first data cracks: JOLTS and Conference Board consumer confidence both surprised on the downside. PCE tonight (8:30pm SGT) is the decider; NFP Friday (cons 100k).

trumpWatch.title: CDL GET+ strategic review fallout: −8.1% Monday, −2.11% Tuesday to S$7.43 — six-week low at ~0.73x P/B
trumpWatch.detail: CDL unveiled its GET+ review Monday ("3,4,5,6": FY2027–29; 4 sectors; S$5bn new investments; S$6bn divestments; ≥35% payout; net gearing 75% to ~55%; >S$1bn PATMI from divestment gains; AUM S$5bn to S$10bn). The market underwhelmed: the divestment target came in below expectations and capital is recycled, not returned. Monday −8.1% to S$7.59 (worst STI performer; Friday close S$8.26 per CDL IR), Tuesday −2.11% to S$7.43. ~10% over two sessions on a 0.6%-of-NW position.

trumpWatch.title: Today's slate: China NBS PMI + Australia CPI this morning; US PCE 8:30pm SGT; Golden Week starts tomorrow; NFP Friday
trumpWatch.detail: Wed: China NBS PMI (Sep) ~09:30 SGT, Australia Aug CPI 09:30 SGT, US ADP, US GDP final Q2, US PCE (Aug) 8:30pm SGT. Thu: Japan Tankan Q3, US ISM Mfg (exp 55.0); mainland China shuts for Golden Week (Oct 1–7). Fri: EZ CPI flash, US NFP (cons 100k vs 162k prev). India shut Friday (Gandhi Jayanti). AI-theme color: OpenAI scrapped the GPT-6.1 "Astra" release over safety concerns (WSJ).
